fields.doc: The strokes are darker than the paper

fields.name: threshold
fields.doc: Brightness that separates strokes from paper

fields.name: thickness
fields.doc: Pixels added on every side of a stroke

fields.doc: Name of what this step makes (default: the op's name)

ops.name: onnx
ops.title: ONNX model
ops.doc: Any image model exported to ONNX (background removal, depth, upscaling, restoration, style): pre- and post-processing from the manifest next to it (<model>.json), or the fields here

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: What the output is (auto: by channel count)

fields.name: apply
fields.doc: Mask models: cut the input out with the mask (transparent background)

fields.name: tile
fields.doc: Fixed-size upscalers: tile overlap in pixels (-1 automatic, 0 never tile)

fields.name: out
fields.doc: Name of what this step makes (default: the op's name)

ops.name: classify
ops.title: Classify
ops.doc: An image classifier exported to ONNX (a content filter, a tagger): scores per frame and label written to a .json file (labels, size and activation from the manifest next to it); the clip itself is unchanged

fields.name: path
fields.doc: Scores file (.json): labels, the highest score per label, and every frame's

ops.name: interpolate
ops.title: Interpolate
ops.doc: RIFE in-between frames (each pass doubles the frame rate)

fields.name: loop
fields.doc: Also between the last and first frame

fields.name: out
fields.doc: Name of what this step makes (default: the op's name)

ops.name: depth_mesh
ops.title: Depth to 3D
ops.doc: A 3D relief of a picture, raised by its depth and textured with it

fields.name: edges
fields.doc: Largest depth step inside a triangle (0..1; 0 keeps all, joining foreground and background)

fields.name: out
fields.doc: Name of what this step makes (default: the op's name)

ops.name: image_to_3d
ops.title: Image to 3D
ops.doc: A whole 3D model from one picture, made by a 3D service (TRELLIS.2 on a GPU); a transparent background is the object's outline

fields.name: in
fields.doc: Picture (with a transparent background: its alpha is the object)

fields.name: out
fields.doc: Name of what this step makes (default: the op's name)

ops.name: rig
ops.title: Auto-rig
ops.doc: A skeleton and skin weights for a 3D model, ready to pose and animate (SkinTokens on a GPU, by a rigging service); saved as .glb

fields.name: postprocess
fields.doc: Smooth the skin weights over the model's volume

fields.name: out
fields.doc: Name of what this step makes (default: the op's name)

ops.name: animate
ops.title: Animate
ops.doc: Moves a rigged figure with motion capture (a .bvh file, as CMU's free library has them): legs, arms, spine and head found on both skeletons, the hips carried along; saved as an animated .glb

fields.name: seconds
fields.doc: How much of the motion (0: all of it)

fields.name: in_place
fields.doc: Keep the figure in place (no walking away)

fields.name: out
fields.doc: Name of what this step makes (default: the op's name)

ops.name: render
ops.title: Render 3D
ops.doc: Pictures of a 3D model: a still, or a turntable clip

fields.name: lighting
fields.doc: Shade by a light (off: flat colours)

fields.name: stereo
fields.doc: Stereo 3D: both eyes' views side by side (half_sbs: in the same width), top and bottom, or red-cyan

fields.name: eye
fields.doc: Stereo: degrees between the two eyes' cameras

fields.name: play
fields.doc: Animated models: play the animation over the frames (frames default to all of it, turn to 0)

fields.name: out
fields.doc: Name of what this step makes (default: the op's name)

ops.name: stereo
ops.title: Stereo 3D
ops.doc: Stereoscopic 3D from pictures or video and their depth: left and right eye views for 3D TVs, VR players and red-cyan glasses

fields.name: layout
fields.doc: half_sbs: both views in the original width (3D TVs, most VR players); sbs: twice as wide; tb: top and bottom; anaglyph: red-cyan glasses

fields.name: strength
fields.doc: Depth effect: largest disparity as a fraction of the width

fields.name: focus
fields.doc: Screen plane (0: everything comes out of the screen, 1: everything behind it)

fields.name: smooth
fields.doc: Video: depth range smoothing between frames (0: none)

fields.name: out
fields.doc: Name of what this step makes (default: the op's name)
